# EU DPP Provider (eudppprovider.com)

> Enterprise Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform and sovereign data vault provider under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (EU Battery Regulation) and ESPR (EU 2024/1781).

## Core Identity & Positioning
- **Brand**: EU DPP Provider
- **Domain**: https://eudppprovider.com
- **Official Business Desk**: info@eudppprovider.com
- **Operating Entity**: SUZHOU GEEKTION TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD (USCI: 91320509MAEM4DKR87)
- **Operating Centers**: Frankfurt am Main & Munich (Germany) / Shanghai & Suzhou (China)
- **Telephone (EU Desk)**: +49 (0) 69 9675 8827
- **Primary Focus**: Digital Product Passport compliance software and 10-year sovereign data hosting for Electric Vehicles (EV), Light Means of Transport (LMT / E-Bike ≤25kg), and Stationary Industrial Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS >2kWh).

## Key Regulatory Milestones & Mandates
- **20 July 2026**: European Commission DG GROW Central DPP Registry entered operational status (`registry.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`).
- **18 August 2026**: Mandatory Carbon Footprint performance class labeling (A–E) applicable to EV traction batteries.
- **18 February 2027**: Mandatory Digital Battery Passport enforcement under Articles 77 & 78 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 across all EV, LMT (≤25kg), and industrial batteries (>2kWh).
- **18 August 2027**: Mandatory supply chain due diligence policies and third-party audit conformity verification under Regulation (EU) 2025/1561.
- **18 February 2028**: Maximum lifecycle carbon footprint thresholds enforced for EV batteries.
- **18 August 2028**: Mandatory recycled content documentation declarations (Cobalt, Lithium, Nickel, Lead).
- **18 August 2031**: Mandatory recycled content minimum percentage targets enforced (Cobalt 16%, Lead 85%, Lithium 6%, Nickel 6%).

## Commercial Delivery Models
1. **Managed Sovereign Cloud Subscription (SaaS)**: 10-year Frankfurt ISO/IEC 27001 data vault hosting, 99.9% uptime SLA guarantee, automated rolling regulatory schema updates, Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) trade secret protection, and global GS1 Digital Link 2D resolution.
2. **Enterprise On-Premise Turnkey Suite**: Private cloud / on-premise deployment, full code and data sovereignty, zero per-scan fees, native read-only MES / ERP / PLM / BMS connectors, historical data cleansing, and on-site commissioning.
3. **Early Adopter Pilot Program**: Pre-validation sandbox for 1–3 battery pack SKUs, field gap audit, and DG GROW Registry pre-filing.
